hypotheses.P1_rank8_layerwise_basis_is_useful: Frozen layerwise rank-8 state-PCA bases have at least 0.75 mean held-out Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.P2_rank16_layerwise_basis_is_nearly_suff: Frozen layerwise rank-16 bases have at least 0.85 Fisher fidelity in every held-out condition.
hypotheses.P3_rank32_layerwise_basis_is_robustly_su: Frozen layerwise rank-32 bases have at least 0.95 Fisher fidelity in every held-out condition.
hypotheses.P4_one_shared_rank32_basis_is_nearly_suf: A single normalized pooled rank-32 basis has at least 0.85 fidelity in every layer, corpus, and distance.
hypotheses.P5_learned_basis_beats_random: At rank 16, the layerwise learned basis exceeds matched random bases by at least 0.20 mean held-out fidelity.
hypotheses.P6_state_variance_predicts_behavior_fron: Across tested ranks, state fidelity and Fisher fidelity have Spearman correlation at least 0.90.
hypotheses.P7_layerwise_orientation_matters: At rank 16, layerwise bases exceed the shared basis by at least 0.05 mean fidelity.
hypotheses.P8_rank16_layerwise_basis_transfers_ood: For every layer, rank-16 OOD mean fidelity is within 0.15 of held-out FineWeb.
hypotheses.P9_non_native_basis_beats_three_native_h: Rank-16 layerwise PCA exceeds the frozen three-head program's mean held-out Fisher fidelity.
